task: Turn a Word document, PowerPoint presentation or Excel workbook into Markdown

x-display.title: Convert Office files to Markdown
x-display.summary: Extract content from DOCX, PPTX or XLSX files into Markdown.
x-display.description: Bring content from Word, PowerPoint or Excel into a text-based workflow for editing, searching or reference. The result focuses on the document’s content rather than recreating its original visual layout.

packaging_note: Builds the pinned Office converters without cloud or audio extras.

inputs.what: a DOCX, PPTX or XLSX file

known_issues: Image-only documents need OCR before they contain readable text.
